name: codex-image-factory
description: Batch image production for Codex with attributed prompt discovery, verified receipts, evaluation, and prompt optimization.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, batch-produce, and evaluate images with Codex
interface.longDescription: Discover attributed prompt directions, then run a reference-driven image production loop inside Codex: validate a batch plan, generate through the built-in image tool, collect a hash-verified receipt for every artifact, evaluate against deterministic gates, and optimize prompts into a new round with explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Find prompt directions for my image batch
Run this image batch plan and collect a receipt for every artifact
Evaluate the generated batch and record my approval labels
